title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.11818v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce MM-ToolSandBox, a benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents. The framework provides a stateful execution environment spanning 500+ tools across 16 application domains, supporting multi-image, multi-turn tasks where agents must ground progressively arriving visual inputs into executable tool calls while handling realistic conversational phenomena (goal revisions, error corrections, state mutations). An automated scenario generation pipeline produces diverse, visually grounded scenarios through information-flow-guided planning and multi-stage quality filtering, yielding 258 human-verified nominal scenarios and 50 variants targeting interactive UI applications. Evaluating 12 state-of-the-art models, from 4B open-weight to frontier proprietary systems, shows that current models still lack robust visual tool-calling capability: even the best model achieves below 50% success rate. translated_title: MM-ToolSandBox：一个用于评估视觉工具调用代理的统一框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.11818v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：我们引入了MM-ToolSandBox，一个用于视觉基础工具调用代理的基准测试和评估框架。该框架提供了一个有状态执行环境，涵盖16个应用领域中的500多个工具，支持多图像、多轮任务，在这些任务中，代理必须将逐步到达的视觉输入转化为可执行的工具调用，同时处理现实对话现象（目标修订、错误纠正、状态变化）。一个自动化场景生成流程通过信息流引导规划和多阶段质量过滤，生成多样化的、视觉基础场景，最终产生258个人工验证的标准场景和50个针对交互式UI应用的变体。评估12个最先进模型，从40亿参数的开源权重模型到前沿专有系统，显示当前模型仍缺乏稳健的视觉工具调用能力：即使最好的模型成功率也低于50%。我们的框架还提供了深入分析，识别了关键失败模式，并强调了在视觉工具调用领域需要进一步研究的领域。
tldr: 该论文提出了MM-ToolSandBox，一个包含500多个工具和258个验证场景的统一基准框架，评估12个先进模型后显示当前视觉工具调用代理的成功率均低于50%，表明该领域仍需显著改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MM-ToolSandBox, a unified benchmark with 500+ tools and 258 validated scenarios, revealing that current visual tool-calling agents achieve success rates below 50%, highlighting significant room for improvement.
